Job Mission: CHANEL is growing in a fast-changing business environment, driving an increasing need to have strategic vision and capabilities in Data Analytics. We must change the way we work; elevating CHANEL’s data as a strategic asset, empowering informed decision-making across the House with trusted data.To achieve this, we need to uphold high-quality and safe data, build robust analytics and insights capabilities, and foster a culture of data-enabled decision making across all aspects of the business. In this context, we are growing our Data Office to provide services throughout the entire data lifecycle.We are looking for a talented Senior Data Governance Analyst to take part of this transformation journey and achieve our ambition. You will act as a subject-matter expert supporting the deployment of a Data Governance framework and key Data initiatives in the APAC region.Key Responsibilities: Reporting to the Data Governance Manager APAC, the incumbent will be responsible for implementing a Global Data Governance framework covering Data Ownership, Critical Data Elements and Data Quality, among other aspects.He/she will also provide data analysis helping the House to improve its data management practices and business processes.Data Ownership Framework

- Assist with the identification of data owners and stewards and ensure adoption of the framework.
- Support them throughout their data governance maturity journey.

Critical Data Elements

- Define the scope of the data that will be under the governance framework with the priority on Critical Data Elements.
- Ensure standards and policies are defined for Critical Data Elements.

Data Quality Management

- Work with business stakeholders to identify and facilitate the production of Data Quality Rules and Data Quality Reporting.
- Identify processes that generates data quality issues and provide analysis and recommendations.
- Responsible for leading the identification, recording and remediation of data quality issues.

Projects

- Provide support as required on data related projects such as, but not limited to, migration activities for coming ERP Transformation program.

Role Specifications:Academic/Professional Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, or related field, or equivalent.
- Data governance / data management professional certification is an advantage.

Work Experience

- Minimum 5 years’ experience with at least 3 years of direct experience in a Data-Governance/Management or prior experience as a Business Analyst working alongside data teams.
- Experience in Retail is an advantage.
- Audit or consulting experience is an advantage.
- Fluent in English is a must and fluent in Mandarin or other Asian language are an advantage.

Required Competencies

- Understanding of key concepts such as Data Catalog, ETL, Data Quality and MDM.
- Excellent problem solving and communication/presentation skills to translate business needs into a data solution.
- Ability to adapt your language to your stakeholders to ensure complex concepts are well understood across the organization.
- Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to build consensus.
- Strong analytical skill and ability to produce data insights out of large datasets.
- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite of applications.
- Ability to use data analytics tools (SQL, Power BI…) is an advantage.
- Good data quality or similar level data analysis experience required.
- Demonstrate determination to achieve goals over time and resilient to pressure.

Key Interactions / Stakeholders: Internal

- Global Data Governance Team.
- CHANEL Tech.
- CHANEL Corporate Functions (example: HR, SC, Legal, Data).
- Divisional Teams.
- CHANEL Internal Audit teams.

External

- Project consultants.
- Vendors.

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to Chanel.

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a**Data Governance Engineer**with focus on data governance policies, processes, standards, and monitoring in compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory frameworks, e.g., GDPR, DPA, ISO, etc. A successful candidate will develop and maintain an internal data catalog with automated data labeling and quality metrics, perform access management and ensure data security best practices.
The Data Governance team in the Commercial Systems unit has a mission to enable a secure and well-governed access to comprehensive data sets originating at many internal and external data sources formed in a data mesh. The team works with well-known open-source data governance tools such as Trino and Ranger, defines and executes data governance processes, and democratizes the data at Canonical.
**Location**: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
**The role entails
**
* Define, monitor, and execute data governance policies
* Design, implement, and maintain data labeling and quality metrics in the data catalog
* Deploy and operate services developed by the team
* Depending on your seniority, coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
* Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
**What we are looking for in you
**
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
* Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
* Experience with data quality, governance, and security processes and tools
* Experience with software development in Python and SQL
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
* Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
**Nice-to-have skills
**
* Performance engineering and security experience
* Experience with Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino
**What we offer colleagues
**We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
**About Canonical
**Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
**We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

### Senior AI Governance Solutions Consultant - Financial Services & Insurance

# Senior AI Governance Solutions Consultant - Financial Services & Insurance

#### Dataiku Singapore 5 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Dataiku has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack — empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.Dataiku’s mission is big: to enable all people throughout companies around the world to use data by removing friction surrounding data access, cleaning, modeling, deployment, and more. But it’s not just about technology and processes; at Dataiku, we also believe that people (including our people!) are a critical piece of the equation.As more and more companies develop their practice of Artificial Intelligence there is a growing need to reinforce their developments and deliverables with governance and controls. Some of the motivations and objectives for this turn to AI governance include improving the efficiency of their AI initiatives, managing risks, securing compliance, aligning to responsible AI or ethical frameworks, having a systematic approach to value monitoring, and more.Dataiku’s AI Governance offer extends across our platform but centers on Govern. Released in 2021, Govern enables organizations to build, formalize, and systematize governance practices aligned to their objectives.Mission DescriptionAs a Senior AI Governance Solutions Consultant with Financial Services & Insurance (FSI) expertise (APAC), reporting to the Senior Director for AI Governance Solutions (UK), you will work with organizations across Asia-Pacific to communicate, demonstrate, and deliver Dataiku’s AI and analytics governance offering. You will also leverage your expertise in FSI to communicate the value of Dataiku across industries within this sector, whether investment, commercial, consumer or insurance.In practice, this means speaking and presenting to diverse audiences, working closely with organizations and their dedicated teams to build or co-develop bespoke governance solutions or help clients envision how Dataiku can be leveraged across diverse FSI use cases.How You’ll Make An Impact

- Represent Dataiku's AI and analytics Governance and FSI Solutions teams in APAC region: Working closely with colleagues based across the world, you will be the primary representative of the Governance Solutions team in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Australia. In addition to your focus on AI and Analytics Governance, you will work closely with the Director for FSI Solutions in order to facilitate demonstrations of how Dataiku works well within this industry.
- Support pre-sales activities on Dataiku’s AI and analytics governance offering: Interest in AI Governance across the region is increasing. With this interest are opportunities to demonstrate to our customers Dataiku's approach and offering on AI and analytics Governance. Practically, you will work alongside account teams with both prospects and existing customers, working tightly with the Sales Engineering community on opportunity management involving AI Governance. Activities will include product demonstration, value proposition presentation, implementation and integration principles, mapping of post-sales planning or simply acting as a key contact point to answer specific questions about the topic or offer.
- Support pre-sales activities on Dataiku's FSI offering: Dataiku continues to see success with FSI organizations across the world. With organizations scaling the use of analytics and data science across teams, new opportunities arise every day to show the potential of Dataiku to support diverse use cases. Practically, this means working closely with account teams, in particular Sales Engineers, to scope solution- or use case-specific demos as well as present our existing solutions where relevant to a given customer.
- Deliver post-sales activities on Dataiku’s AI governance offer: Lead mapping of customer governance principles to product capabilities, plan required workshops, down to actual delivery of customized workflows and user training. The AI Governance Consultant will ensure end-to-end delivery as well as support internal and partner resources on projects, with one shared objective: delivery of value-generating governance for our customers.
- Deliver post-sales activities on the potential of Dataiku in FSI: Work closely with the Director of FSI Solutions and customers to envision new ways of working with Dataiku and, where relevant, advise and support our Global Services organization with build and implementation of discrete use cases.
- Consistently implement an efficient approach to end-to-end implementation of Dataiku’s AI Governance offer: ensuring key customer stakeholders are involved in governance discussions; conducting deep dives on customer needs, requirements, and challenges; identifying and advising on customer AI governance frameworks; supporting colleagues on sales; and mapping customer requirements to Dataiku’s product range.
- Establish your position as Dataiku’s regional epicenter for expertise on AI Governance & FSI: Proactively engage internal and external stakeholders as an AI Governance SME with FSI expertise through participating in internal upskilling sessions and external-facing panels and speaking engagements.
- Contribute to product development: Work tightly with the Product team in charge of Dataiku’s dedicated product to shape the roadmap, reporting own and customer feedback.
- Exercise business/policy expertise and technical skills in the ideation and development of Governance Solutions and Customer Customizations: with respect to solutions, identify opportunities to build standalone AI Governance solutions that speak to market needs, translating existing regulation, policy, or practices into solutions; with respect to customizations, work closely with customers to understand their requirements and demonstrate facility in translating these into the product through unique workflow (Govern-only) or unique workflows with relevant features across the Dataiku platform.
- Actively contribute to all other activities handled by Dataiku’s team of AI Governance experts: AI regulatory watch, marketing, awareness, internal enablement, support to development of a strong partner network.

What You Need To Be Successful

- Masters degree, 7 to 10 years of work experience with outstanding track record in complex project management and roll-out, with the capacity to move from initial initiative design to program roll-out; 1 to 3 years of direct AI and Analytics Governance experience preferred.
- Proven expertise in governance or regulation-related topics. A good understanding of AI and related governance needs or direct experience with AI governance will be a plus.
- Ability to gain competence and expertise with our product offering and its capabilities and translate customers’ scoped needs and requirements into technical and practical solutions.
- Strong translational skills with ability to listen to customers’ needs and requirements and identify or propose relevant practical solutions.
- Both able to make detailed recommendations and not afraid to actually do the work.
- Capable of handling projects end-to-end in an autonomous and inclusive manner, and of sharing best practices with all stakeholders.
- Capable of strong People and Relationship management and at ease working with others, whether collaborating with colleagues across teams or supporting and advising customers across geographies.
- Great communication skills (both written and oral), able to clearly articulate and present complex situations and concepts in a way that is understood by diverse audiences.
- Adaptable, Professional, Challenge Seeker, Resilient
- Based in Singapore (remote or office based)
- Fluent in English is mandatory, Business-level proficiency in Malay, Mandarin, and/or Thai a plus.

What are you waiting for!At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.comProtect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activityDataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

****Job Description
****We are seeking an experienced Data Governance Manager to drive the implementation of data governance at NUS.
This role is responsible for leading and overseeing data governance initiatives, including the development and enforcement of data policies, procedures, guidelines, and standards across the University.
Key responsibilities include leading data asset, data quality, data protection, and data sharing governance, as well as raising awareness of data governance through training programs.
This role will be instrumental in evolving current data governance practices to address future needs by incorporating new business and regulatory requirements and leveraging innovative technologies.
Additionally, this role offers opportunities to manage data product projects that empower the University in areas such as analytics, data science, and AI.
Duties and Responsibilities
* Data Policy and Process: Develop, review, and communicate data policies, procedures, guidelines, and standards.
* Data Asset Management: Manage data asset initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders to develop data catalog and data lineage.
* Data Quality Management: Manage data quality initiatives by working with stakeholders to monitor data quality health and resolve issues.
* Data Protection Management: Manage data protection initiatives and collaborate with compliance and security teams to establish appropriate data protection governance.
* Data Sharing & Disclosure: Develop, review, and communicate data sharing and disclosure governance with stakeholders to ensure secure and effective democratization of data.
* Training and Awareness: Develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote the adoption of data governance practices.
* Data Product Management: Lead and manage data product projects, including requirement analysis, participation in solution design, planning, testing, and implementation.
****Qualifications
****
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in data governance roles
* Project Management certification e.g. PMP
Skills & Competencies
* Technical Skills:
* Proficiency in data governance tools (e.g. metadata, data quality, data marketplace)
* Familiarity with Microsoft SharePoint and Power Platform (e.g. Power BI, Power Apps)
* Data Management Skills: Strong understanding of data management principles and best practices (e.g. DAMA, data privacy)
* Regulatory Knowledge: Good knowledge of data protection regulations and standards (e.g., PDPA, GDPR)
* Project Management: Ability to manage projects, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex data governance concepts to diverse audiences.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to breakdown complex problems into manageable parts
* Interpersonal Skills: Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
**Personal Traits:
**
* Meticulous: Demonstrates a high level of quality and thoroughness in work.
* Independent and Self-motivated: Capable of working independently with minimal supervision and guidance.
* Proactive: Takes initiative in identifying and solving problems, anticipating issues, and implementing solutions.
* Critical Thinker: Willing to challenge the status quo and advocate for improvements in data governance practice.
* Agile and Nimble: Able to adapt, respond and cope with changes in roles and work priorities.

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a**Data Governance Engineer**with focus on data governance policies, processes, standards, and monitoring in compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory frameworks, e.g., GDPR, DPA, ISO, etc. A successful candidate will develop and maintain an internal data catalog with automated data labeling and quality metrics, perform access management and ensure data security best practices.
The Data Governance team in the Commercial Systems unit has a mission to enable a secure and well-governed access to comprehensive data sets originating at many internal and external data sources formed in a data mesh. The team works with well-known open-source data governance tools such as Trino and Ranger, defines and executes data governance processes, and democratizes the data at Canonical.
**Location**: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
**The role entails
**
* Define, monitor, and execute data governance policies
* Design, implement, and maintain data labeling and quality metrics in the data catalog
* Deploy and operate services developed by the team
* Depending on your seniority, coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
* Develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
**What we are looking for in you
**
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
* Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
* Experience with data quality, governance, and security processes and tools
* Experience with software development in Python and SQL
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
* Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
**Nice-to-have skills
**
* Performance engineering and security experience
* Experience with Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino
**What we offer colleagues
**We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
**About Canonical
**Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
**We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

## BeOne Medicines provided pay range

### Base pay range

$71.43/yr - $71.43/yr

Temporary work opportunities align well with professionals seeking career flexibility and non-traditional ways of working, while being driven to deliver exceptional results in high-profile environments. Magnit Direct Source is a service offered by Magnit Global that connects top talent directly to industry-leading clients with flexible temporary assignments across a variety of impactful projects.BeOne Medicines is creating the world’s next generation cancer treatments. As a global oncology company focused on uniting against cancer, BeOne Medicines brings together passional professionals dedicated to making a difference for patients worldwide.This opportunity is part of BeOne’s Contingent Workforce Program in partnership with Magnit Global. As a temporary contractor supporting BeOne Medicines, you will be employed by our contingent talent partner, Magnit Global, who manages BeOne’s contingent and temporary workforce.Magnit Global is a leading workforce solutions and technology company specializing in contingent workforce management. Magnit partners with organizations across industries including healthcare, pharmaceuticals, research and development, consumer electronics and more. Magnit offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).General DescriptionBeOne is seeking an Enterprise Data Governance leader to build, enable, and scale enterprise data governance and stewardship capabilities across the organization. This role is a critical position within the Enterprise Data Governance function and is responsible for the day-to-day execution and operationalization of data stewardship across business and data domains operating in a federated governance model.Working closely with the Head of Enterprise Data Governance, this position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on enterprise data governance and stewardship, translating governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, adoptable processes. The Enterprise Data Stewardship Manager will coordinate stewardship activities, lead domain onboarding into the enterprise governance model, and manage the execution of key governance initiatives, including an enterprise data classification project aligned to the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) Data Security Regulation (Executive Order 14117).This role will help lead managed service providers and mentor Data Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) team members, track performance, and provide transparent reporting on stewardship progress, risks, and key performance indicators (KPIs). The position requires strong cross-functional partnership with business, IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure trusted, compliant, and well-governed enterprise data assets that support analytics, AI readiness, and regulatory obligations.Essential Functions Of The Job

- Act as a SME for enterprise data governance and data stewardship, contributing to governance operating models, policies, standards, procedures, and best practices.
- Lead and execute domain onboarding into the federated data governance model, including role enablement, training, and adoption of governance processes and tools.
- Enable streamlined data discovery and access to data products and assets by implementing an Enterprise Data Catalog & Marketplace.
- Manage data governance projects and oversee execution of key initiatives
- Enterprise data classification and tagging aligned to the DOJ Data Security Rule
- Design and implement workflows for metadata enrichment, glossary curation, and data stewardship, enabling and empowering stakeholders to take ownership of their data.
- Integrated processes and potentially alternative platforms (Informatica, ServiceNow, Jira)
- Influence and drive adoption of data governance and stewardship practices without direct authority by partnering with cross functional and domain teams to embed governance into day-to-day execution.
- Explore opportunities to incorporate emerging AI technologies to streamline data stewardship and governance processes.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships across business, technology, security, legal, and compliance stakeholders to align on shared outcomes, priorities, and acceptable trade-offs.
- Resolve conflicts and competing priorities by facilitating structured decision discussions, and aligning stakeholders viable governance approaches that balance regulatory risk, data quality, and delivery timelines.
- Conduct user training and engagement sessions to promote adoption of data governance tools and practices.
- Establish, monitor, and report on data governance and stewardship KPIs, including domain onboarding progress, steward engagement, metadata coverage, and classification adoption.
- Report regularly on team performance, initiative status, risks, and outcomes to the Data Governance Lead.
- Partner with platform owners and architects to ensure effective use of data governance platforms to support stewardship workflows, metadata management, and regulatory compliance.
- Clear communication skills for explaining data governance essentials to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Author data policies, processes, and procedures per best practice data management standards to support the data governance program, data governance initiatives, and data projects.
- Pilot new approaches to data governance, gathering feedback to refine and optimize processes.
- Monitor and report on the effectiveness of data governance initiatives, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Author data policies, processes, and procedures per best practice data management standards to support the data governance program, data governance initiatives, and data projects.

Education/Experience Required

- Bachelor’s Degree with 7+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, or enterprise data management roles.
- Demonstrated experience acting as a data governance and stewardship SME within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
- Proven ability to influence outcomes without formal authority, evidenced by successful adoption of governance processes, standards, or platforms across multiple domains or business units.
- Experience managing or coordinating data governance projects and initiatives across business and technical teams.
- Experience driving adoption of governance processes, tools, or standards through persuasion, collaboration, and credibility, rather than mandate.
- Hands-on experience with enterprise data governance platforms - Informatica (IDMC/CDGC/CDQ/CDMP), Atlan, Alation, or equivalent tools and setting those up for optimal adoption by domain.
- Comfortable to train data stewards and data owners to effectively use the tool to enhance data governance.
- Experience with data classification, metadata management, and regulatory-aligned data governance practices.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate differing incentives across business, IT, security, legal, and compliance functions.
- Experience mentoring or managing team members, including performance tracking and coaching.
- Strong ability to translate governance strategy and policy into practical, executable processes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience managing and leading the enablement/adoption of Informatica data governance platforms with data stewards in various functions. (IDMC/CDGC/CDQ/CDMP,AXON)
- Strong facilitation skills, including leading workshops, onboarding sessions, and governance working groups.
- Experience governing data as a product within modern data platforms DataBricks, Snowflake.
- Experience supporting or implementing DOJ Data Security Rule–aligned data classification and tagging programs.
- Experience with data in a regulated environment, particularly GxP, clinical trial data, or R&D data.
- Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industries is strongly preferred.
- Experience defining and reporting governance and stewardship KPIs for leadership audiences.
- Experience with data quality, data platforms, and analytics ecosystems and how stewardship supports downstream use cases.
- Relevant certifications such as DCAM(Data Management Capability Assessment Model), CDMP, DGSP, DAMA-related certifications, or equivalent experience.

**Data Governance Analyst (Energy Sector)**
📍**Location:**Charleroi, Belgium (2 days/week on-site)
🔍**Seniority:**Medior (3–5 years)
A leading company in the**energy sector**is looking for a**Data Governance Analyst**to join its Data Management department for an estimated 8-month full-time mission.
While partial remote work is possible, a**minimum on-site presence of 2 days per week**is required in Gosselies. Access to a personal vehicle is preferred, as the location is not easily reachable by public transport.
🔧**Your Role**
As a**Data Governance Analyst**, you will support the Data Governance Lead and contribute to the implementation and enforcement of data governance policies across the organization. Your key responsibilities include:
* Supporting the rollout of data governance policies, standards, and processes
* Collaborating with the data quality team to manage and apply data quality standards
* Mapping data flows across the organization and developing a data glossary
* Ensuring security and privacy compliance through audits and documentation
* Promoting best practices in collaboration with business, IT, and data teams
* Contributing to internal training and awareness efforts
✅**Required Skills & Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Business, or similar
* **Fluent French (C2 level)**
* Proven experience in data governance roles
* Strong knowledge of data management principles and data quality
* Experience with tools such as**Collibra, Purview, Precisely, Alation**, etc.
* Strong understanding of**data privacy, compliance, and security**
* Skilled in creating data glossaries and managing documentation
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
⭐**Nice-to-Have**
* Knowledge of GDPR, ISO27001
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies
* Understanding of project management principles

# Data and AI Governance Leader

#### Helia Sydney, New South Wales, Australia 1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Helia has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

Helia, as Australia’s first Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI) provider, with over 50 years expertise in the Australian housing market are in the process of re-inventing ourselves.We exist to accelerate financial wellbeing through home ownership, now and for the future. Our mission is to create innovative and tailored solutions in partnership with our customers. We aim to do this efficiently and conveniently, leveraging state of the art technology and data solutions.The Data & AI Governance Leader is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating governance frameworks across Data and AI at Helia. This role ensures that data is trusted, well-managed, and compliant, and that AI systems are governed effectively across their lifecycle.Working under the direction of the Director of AI & Data, this role translates enterprise governance strategy into practical, scalable controls, processes, and standards that enable safe, compliant, and high-quality use of data and AI.ResponsibilitiesGovernance frameworks & operating model

- Design and implement enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and operating models
- Establish and maintain AI governance frameworks covering AI system lifecycle, approvals, and monitoring
- Define roles and responsibilities for data ownership, stewardship, and accountability
- Embed governance practices across business and technology teams

Data quality & stewardship

- Lead enterprise data quality initiatives, including definition of standards and metrics
- Establish processes for identifying, tracking, and remediating data quality issues
- Partner with domain owners and data stewards to uplift data quality across critical datasets
- Implement reporting and dashboards to monitor data quality performance

AI governance & model risk

- Operationalise AI governance controls, including risk screening and assessment and model validation, approval, monitoring and evaluation processes
- Establish and run model risk management practices aligned to regulatory expectations
- Ensure appropriate documentation, explainability, and auditability of AI systems
- Monitor adherence to AI governance standards and escalate risks as required

Policies, standards & compliance

- Develop and maintain data and AI policies, standards, and guidelines
- Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, internal risk frameworks, and audit expectations
- Support internal and external audits related to data and AI governance
- Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure alignment

Governance forums & controls

- Establish and run governance forums
- Ensure governance decisions are documented, communicated, and enforced
- Track compliance with governance processes and drive remediation where needed

Stakeholder engagement & enablement

- Work closely with cross-functional teams to embed governance practices
- Provide guidance and support to data owners, stewards, and AI engineers
- Drive awareness and adoption of governance standards across the organisation

Continuous improvement

- Monitor effectiveness of governance frameworks and identify opportunities for uplift
- Stay informed of evolving regulatory and industry best practices
- Drive continuous improvement in governance processes, tooling, and reporting

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in data governance, data management, risk, or related domains
- Proven experience implementing enterprise data governance and/or AI governance frameworks
- Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, and stewardship practices
- Experience with AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI practices
- Familiarity with regulatory environments (preferably financial services)
- Experience working cross-functionally with business, technology, and risk teams
- Demonstrated people leadership experience, including building, leading, and developing teams
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Ability to translate policy into practical, operational processes

At Helia, we are building a team focused on opportunities: creating brighter futures for our people. When you come to work at Helia, you’re joining an organisation that cares about what’s important to you. Whether it’s greater work-life balance, flexible working arrangements or looking after your wellbeing, we provide access to benefits that help support you both professionally and personally.Helia is a place where you can grow and make a difference. We provide a great learning culture, where cross collaboration, training and innovation happens to embrace and embed a customer service culture. We are based in the heart of North Sydney, with spacious offices and some of the most fantastic views in Sydney!If you are interested in joining a company where you can realise your full potential and grow, we would love to hear from you!We have a diverse business community: our people, our customers and communities are reflective of this and as an organisation we are committed to continually hiring a diverse workforce. We ensure our people always feel supported and we do this by our openness to flexible work options and our commitment to inclusion, regardless of career level, life-stage, or experience.

# Senior Manager, Data Governance

#### White & Case LLP London, England, United Kingdom 1 week ago 103 applicants See who White & Case LLP has hired for this role

- Report this job

NAThe Senior Manager, Data Governance is a strategic leadership role responsible for advancing, maturing, and optimising the Firm’s Data Governance Framework and broader data strategy. The role focuses on embedding data governance practices into business-as-usual operations, improving data quality, reducing risk, and enabling the effective use of data to support analytics, reporting, integrations, and emerging AI capabilities.The Data Governance Framework provides the structure and operating model to drive effective data management and influence data-related behaviours across the Firm. It has established the mechanisms for oversight, control (planning, monitoring, and enforcement), and leadership of data governance activities.The Framework comprises a C-Suite Steering Committee, a Director-level Data Governors Board, and a Data Stewardship Council, supported by Technology, Information Governance, Data Governance, and Data Privacy Office (DPO) teams. Its objective is to improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of data assets, enabling their use to drive competitive advantage.Operating within the Practice Solutions Function, this role is global and highly cross-functional, working closely with senior stakeholders across Technology, Business Intelligence, Data Architecture, Information Governance, and the Data Privacy Office, as well as technical and functional Data Stewards throughout the Firm. The Senior Manager plays a critical role in ensuring the Firm’s data is trusted, well-managed, and positioned to deliver measurable business value.The role provides leadership to the Data Governance team and the wider governance community, including the Data Governors Board and Data Stewardship Council, ensuring consistent adoption, clear accountability, and alignment with business priorities and regulatory expectations. This requires a balance of both a bottom-up and top-down approach to embedding and supporting effective Data Governance.In addition, the Senior Manager partners closely with Business Intelligence, Knowledge Solutions and Innovation teams to ensure strong data governance foundations underpin the data and analytics, knowledge management, enterprise search, automation, and AI-driven initiatives across the Firm.Duties And Accountabilities

- Evolve and drive the strategic direction and continued maturity of the Firm’s Data Governance Framework, transitioning it towards a scalable, embedded, and value-driven operating model.Lead, mentor, and develop the Data Governance team, providing clear direction, prioritisation, and oversight across all governance activities.Chair the Data Governors Board and provide leadership oversight to the Data Stewardship Council, driving engagement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration across teams and regions.
- Embed data governance into business-as-usual processes, ensuring data ownership, stewardship, and accountability are consistently applied across the Firm.
- Enhance and optimise data governance policies, standards, operating models, and controls to ensure consistency, scalability, and regulatory alignment.
- Define, standardise, and govern the Firm’s data domain model, ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and alignment to business capabilities across our regions, business functions and practices.
- Drive measurable improvements in data quality, governance adoption, and data-related business outcomes across key domains.
- Define, monitor, and continuously improve data quality frameworks, metrics, and remediation processes to enhance data accuracy, completeness, and integrity.
- Own and drive the Firm’s central reference data strategy, establishing, driving adoption, and continuously improving a controlled, scalable, and authoritative approach to managing reference data across systems and processes.
- Define and support the adoption of external and industry data standards (e.g. SALI, NosLegal), ensuring alignment with internal data models and maximising consistency, interoperability, and business value.
- Oversee and optimise the Firm’s Data Management Technology (DMT), ensuring effective use of metadata, lineage, reference data, and workflow capabilities to support data governance objectives.
- Partner with senior stakeholders (including leadership-suite) to align data governance with Firm and Functional strategic priorities: including analytics, automation, and AI initiatives.
- Support and enable Knowledge Solutions initiatives by ensuring high-quality, well-governed data foundations for knowledge management, enterprise search, and content intelligence capabilities.
- Oversee the identification, prioritisation, and resolution of critical data issues, ensuring robust governance, escalation, and tracking mechanisms are in place.
- Collaborate with Business Intelligence, Data Architecture, and Technology teams to support enterprise data platform initiatives and ensure governance is embedded by design.
- Oversee the maintenance and effective use of key data governance artefacts, including business glossaries, data dictionaries, lineage, and reference data repositories.
- Drive initiatives to improve data literacy and promote a strong data-driven culture across the Firm.
- Provide data governance oversight and strategic input into major transformation programmes, ensuring alignment with data governance principles and long-term data strategy.
- Manage relationships with third-party vendors and consultants supporting data management tooling and initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelors or Masters degree
- Significant experience in data governance, data management, or related disciplines, with clear progression into leadership roles.
- Proven experience advancing and maturing data governance frameworks within complex, global organisations.
- Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, data domains, and reference data management best practices.
- Experience with data management technologies (e.g. Collibra, Informatica, Data360).
- Experience defining and implementing data domain models and/or reference data strategies at scale is highly desirable.
- Familiarity with external or industry data standards (e.g. SALI, NosLegal) and their practical application is advantageous.
- Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
- Experience leading and developing high-performing teams and fostering engaged, cross-functional data communities.
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into practical governance outcomes.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
- Experience enabling analytics, reporting, or AI initiatives through strong data governance and data management practices.
- Familiarity with Knowledge Solutions or Knowledge Management capabilities (e.g. enterprise search, content management, or legal knowledge systems) is advantageous.
- Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall delivery methodologies.

What We OfferWhen you join us, you’ll be working directly with partners, business leaders and many other inspiring colleagues across our global network of offices. We live by our values—to be pioneering, united and human—and we believe that you’ll experience them from your first day. We will give you the support and development opportunities that will help you achieve your potential.We believe that consistent high performance merits reward and support. Our compensation package reflects your calibre as a business development professional, and our benefits are designed to support your changing needs and priorities across different life stages.OtherOur standard office hours are 09:30-18:00, with a current requirement for 4 days in the office per week.Firm BenefitsWe offer a flexible range of benefits, services and programmes designed to help support your lifestyle requirements. Some of the benefits currently available include:

- Private medical insurance
- Pension plan with matched employer contribution up to 7.5%
- Yearly wellbeing fund
- Income protection

We will be happy to work with you.The Firm may modify and amend any job description at any time in its sole discretion. **About us**
DS Smith is a leading provider of sustainable fibre-based packaging worldwide, which is supported by recycling and papermaking operations. We play a central role in the value chain across sectors including e-commerce, fast moving consumer goods and industrials. Through our purpose of ‘Redefining Packaging for a Changing World’ and our*Now and Next*sustainability strategy, we are committed to leading the transition to the circular economy, while delivering more circular solutions for our customers and wider society –replacing problem plastics, taking carbon out of supply chains and providing innovative recycling solutions.
**About the role**
**We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Governance Analyst to join our team and support the Data Governance programme.**You will work closely with the Data Governance Manager and the Master Data Team to ensure Data Governance best practices are developed and implemented across the Packaging Division. You will also provide support to the Master Data owners in the development of new data assets.
Your remit will include but not limited to:
* Support the development of Policies, Procedures and Data Standards to be used within the Packaging Division.
* Support the creation and maintenance of data dictionaries, business term glossaries, metadata catalogues and data lineage documentation.
* Work with business representatives and Master Data domain owners to identify, document, develop, implement and report data quality rules.
* Support on the planning, running and documenting Data Governance Council sessions.
* Support on the analysis of data by profiling it, documenting findings and recommending remedial actions.
* Assist with the development of new Master Data assets, providing analytical support on new data loads, checking compliance with the specification and assessment of completeness & data quality.
* Support the Master Data domain owners with user acceptance testing.
**About you**
* Educated to a degree level, preferably in Information Management, Data Science, Business or related field.
* Proven experience in data governance, data management or a related role.
* Solid understanding of data quality principles and the benefits of accurate and actionable data.
* Technical knowledge and experience in Data Governance, Data Quality and Data Profiling tools.
* Previous experience in working with large volumes of data; confident with MS Office 365 applications (PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint).
* Data driven, methodical and solution oriented.
* Curious, commercially aware and willing to challenge current practices where appropriate, in order to improve the impact master data has on the business.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, other languages are advantageous.
* Ability to work in a team and independently, and engage with stakeholders across different business areas and IT.
**Benefits**
* Competitive salary.
* Discretionary bonus.
* Annual entitlement to eco vouchers.
* Meal vouchers.
* Entitlement to enrolment in the standard company hospitalisation scheme.
**Location: Brussels –hybrid**

Are you passionate about data and do you, just like us, understand that data is an asset which needs to be managed properly along its life cycle to generate value?
If so, you came to the right place at BearingPoint to
**Become part of our open, empowering and inclusive culture**
We offer varied and rewarding careers in an empowering environment founded on our values of commitment, teaming and excellence**.**You will enjoy high levels of empowerment and personal development with the chance to make a real difference to our firm and our clients.
**Make a difference, in a passionate and engaging team…**
At BearingPoint, we pride ourselves on being easy to work with. You’ll work in friendly and engaging teams in a high-trust environment. You’ll be able to develop new capabilities in emerging disciplines, work in a diverse inclusive culture, with world-class experts, at a variety of locations. Through stewardship we focus on your good long-term growth and development.
**…on consulting and technology solutions that shape the market and our future**
Working on leading-edge, innovative solutions to address emerging business challenges, you will have the opportunity to make a difference in genuine partnership with market-leading clients, impacting the way people work and live in the future.
**Join our Belgian practice**
We are an enthusiastic and fast-growing team with a start-up spirit in an environment that is embedded in the BearingPoint European partnership.
We are offering you an interesting and challenging position as***Data Governance Expert****.*
**You will take responsibility for:**
* Engaging with our clients to develop a data-driven culture
* Enabling our international clients to deliver business value based on data
* Embedding our best in class operating models and adapting them to support the data governance transformation projects that deliver true business value.
* Providing processes, methods, and tools to manage data assets
****
**What we expect from you:**
Generally:
* Strong analytical skills & rational thinking
* Proactive attitude & entrepreneurial mindset
* Strong presentation and communication skills towards both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* A team player that is customer-success-oriented
* Fluent in English and French or/and Dutch
* Most importantly candidates should be looking for a career not just a job. They must have a real commitment to consulting and a passion for delivering high value work to our clients.
Experience in Data Governance:
* Understanding of data strategy challenges
* Knowledge and practical expertise in data governance architecture definition and implementation
* Experience with business process design & modelling
* Experience with metadata integration, data quality, data profiling and metadata management
* Practical expertise in at least one of the following tools Collibra, Informatica, Data Galaxy Magnitude, Talend, Alation, IBM Watson Knowledge Catalog or related
Knowledge of regulatory frameworks & compliance:
* Understanding of GDPR relation and impact on data management
Experience as a Data Professional:
* Experience of data models, data structure, data workflows
Knowledge of Data Architectures:
* Understanding of Business Intelligence and Data warehousing concepts & various methodologies
* Experience in defining and implementing data management frameworks
* Interest in Next Gen Data Management (e.g. Machine Learning Data Catalog)
**What we offer you:**
We are offering you an exciting and interesting job as part of a dynamic, international company, where you get the chance to work in professional, multidisciplinary teams.
We offer an attractive salary package, including a company car with fuel card or a mobility budget allowance, mobile phone, laptop, hospitalization cover, group insurance and lunch vouchers. Furthermore, we offer excellent opportunities to learn by additional training and education and help you realize your career objectives.
Sounds like an ambitious and appealing environment you want to be part of?
Please apply. Come and see!

We are global private markets specialists delivering tailored investment solutions, advisory services, and impactful, data driven insights to the world’s investors. Leveraging the power of our platform and our peerless intelligence across sectors, strategies, and geographies, we help identify the advantages and the answers our clients need to succeed.Position OverviewWe are seeking a motivated Junior Data Governance Analyst with a focus on Security Master Data to join our team. The ideal candidate will have some experience or academic background in finance, data management, or information technology. This role will involve supporting the management and enhancement of our security master data processes, ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and contributing to the firm's investment strategies through high-quality data management.Essential Job Functions:

- Security Master Data Management: Contribute to the management and maintenance of security master data, ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability.
- Private Markets Knowledge: Utilize your foundational knowledge of private markets, particularly private debt, to support the enhancement of security master data quality.
- Data Governance Support: Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures for security master data.
- Data Quality Monitoring: Help in developing and implementing metrics and KPIs to monitor data quality and perform regular audits to ensure data accuracy.
- Issue Resolution: Work with senior team members to identify and resolve data quality issues, assisting in proactive prevention of future occurrences.
- Project Assistance: Contribute to projects related to data governance, security master data enhancements.
- Reporting: Assist in producing reports on data governance activities, data quality, and project progress for internal use.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

- University Degree in Finance, Business, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 1-2 years of relevant experience in data governance, data management, or financial data analysis.
- Experience in Private markets, particularly private debt, is an advantage.
- Basic understanding of data governance principles, practices, and frameworks.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and take initiative in a supportive role.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Other Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

- Familiarity with data management tools and systems (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit EDM, S&P CapIQ) is a plus but not required.
- Basic knowledge of Excel, and other data analysis tools.
- Analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to learn quickly and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Highly motivated, with a desire to grow and develop within the field of data governance and security master data management.
- Interest in global financial markets.

ResponsibilitiesTeam IntroductionThe AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed foundational models across modalities and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. We work across the data lifecycle, from defining evaluation approaches and translating user feedback and benchmark outcomes into data requests, to building scalable processes that improve data quality and support rapid model iteration.Our team combines technical and operational capabilities, bringing together multidisciplinary talent across product management, data engineering, and data operations. Our work is driven by people who think deeply about model behavior, move quickly to solve complex problems, and bring first-hand experience as both builders and users of models and agents.In close partnership with Seed researchers, industry experts, and leading data vendors, we tackle challenging data problems at the frontier of AI development, helping improve both model performance and user experience.AI Data & Safety - External Partnership Development Team is dedicated to continuously sourcing high-quality data suppliers for foundation models and AI-native applications. Based on the data requirements of model training, the team conducts market research and manages the end-to-end process—from supplier sourcing and evaluation, commercial negotiations, and project initiation, to final delivery. By efficiently fulfilling data requests and building a robust supplier ecosystem, the team provides a reliable, high-quality data foundation for the continuous iteration of our models.AI Training Data Market Research and Resource Development1. Partner closely with AI model training teams to understand business needs, define data types, standards, and core requirements, and conduct structured industry and market research to stay abreast of AI data trends, market landscape, and technological advancements2. Translate market insights into high-quality data resource development strategies by identifying and engaging startups and leading data suppliers; establish effective supplier evaluation and screening mechanisms; and expand and onboard suppliers to build a robust, high-quality data ecosystem3. Conduct strategic analysis of market, supplier, and industry data to extract actionable insights; produce analytical reports to support decision-making in AI model training, data procurement, and business strategy4. Continuously identify and monitor emerging data resources and potential partners, maintain strong market relationships, and ensure access to forward-looking, high-quality data sourcesSupplier Onboarding, Delivery, and Lifecycle Management1. Lead supplier onboarding, including evaluation, qualification review, and capability validation, ensuring alignment with project delivery standards and seamless integration into internal workflows2. Manage end-to-end commercial engagements with suppliers, including contract negotiation, terms drafting, cost control, and compliance review, ensuring efficient and compliant partnerships while optimising commercial terms3. Oversee supplier delivery across projects by coordinating internal and external stakeholders, clarifying requirements (even in ambiguous scenarios), managing expectations, and ensuring timely, high-quality data delivery aligned with project goals4. Maintain and develop long-term supplier relationships; regularly evaluate supplier performance and service quality; optimise supplier management frameworks; and leverage data analysis to generate insights and improve supplier performance and collaboration valueQualificationsMinimum Qualifications1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or related fields; candidates with relevant AI data industry internship or project experience will also be considered.2. At least 2 years of relevant experience in AI data services, data sourcing, supplier/vendor management, or business development. 3. Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to independently conduct market research, synthesise insights, and solve complex problems.4. Proven ability in supplier sourcing and channel development, with strong business acumen and the ability to identify and match high-quality resources to business needs.5. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous situations across multiple stakeholders.6. Basic project management capabilities, with the ability to plan, execute, and monitor supplier onboarding and delivery processes, ensuring timelines, quality, and risk control; strong data analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to derive insights and drive process improvements7. Highly agile, detail-oriented, and execution-focused, with strong ownership, resilience under a challenging environment, and a collaborative mindsetPreferred Qualifications1. Familiarity with AI training data markets, data types, and supplier ecosystems is preferred; experience with leading AI data companies is a plusAbout Doubao (Seed)Established in 2023, the ByteDance Seed team is dedicated to pioneering new paths toward artificial general intelligence. We aspire to advance the frontier of intelligence to drive progress for both technology and society.​​With a long-term vision for the AI sector, the Seed team's research spans MLLM, GenMedia, AI for Science, and Robotics. We maintain a global presence with laboratories and career opportunities across China, Singapore, and the United States. To date, we have launched industry-leading general foundation models and cutting-edge multimodal capabilities. Our technology powers over 50 application scenarios — including Doubao, Jimeng, TRAE, Dola and Dreamnia — and serves enterprise customers through Volcano Engine and BytePlus. Third-party data shows that the Doubao App ranks first in user volume in the Chinese market, while Doubao foundation models lead the industry in average daily token consumption.​Why Join ByteDanceInspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day.​As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​Diversity & Inclusion​ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

# Group Function - Privacy Legal Counsel

#### NetEase Games Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR 3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who NetEase Games has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

About The Company：

NetEase, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTES and HKEX: 9999) is a global powerhouse in the Internet and online game industry, with a market capitalization of $80+ billion and more than 25,000 employees worldwide. The NetEase group encompasses a range of innovative businesses centered around content creation, including:

NetEase Games, one of the largest and most renowned game developers worldwide by size, revenue and game offerings. Over the years, NetEase Games has focused on developing high quality content and providing the best experience for gamers around the world;

- Youdao (NYSE: DAO), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading technology-focused intelligent learning company;
- Cloud Music (HKEX: 9899), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading online music content community;
- Yanxuan, NetEase’s private label consumer lifestyle brand; and
- Other innovative businesses, including, among others, an online payment platform and to-B AI technology solutions provider.

About this Role:

We are seeking a mid-level Group Privacy Legal Counsel with 4–8 years of experience to join our legal team. You will manage global privacy compliance, mitigate data risks, and support cross-functional teams on privacy-by-design initiatives, reporting to NetEase’s Head of Privacy & Data Protection. You will also support cybersecurity risk management and compliance with emerging AI regulations and related matters.

This position is part of the Group International Legal department which oversees legal matters for the NetEase group (ex-China) and coordinates with the legal teams within each division of the group.

Responsibilities Include:

- Compliance Management: Maintain and update global privacy policies, notices, and internal frameworks for our global business units, including online games, music streaming, e-commerce, e-sports, intelligent learning, and others.
- Product Counseling: Work with product and engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default and responsible AI principles into product lifecycles.
- Risk Assessments: Provide legal guidance on cross-border data transfers and data localization requirements and conduct, review, and document Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs).
- Contract Management: Draft, negotiate, and review Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) as well as the data privacy-related provisions in a wide range of commercial agreements with third parties, including IP licensing and software co-development agreements.
- Incident Response: Investigate potential data/cybersecurity incidents and manage regulatory notification obligations.
- Employee Training: Design and deliver privacy and AI awareness training across global offices.
- Regulatory Monitoring: Track emerging privacy and AI laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, EU AI Act, EU Digital Services Act, local regulations) and update frameworks.
- Outside Counsel: Collaborate and coordinate with outside counsel across various jurisdictions.
- Other: Take on other relevant duties as assigned and commensurate with your ability.

Requirements:

- Qualification: Qualified lawyer in the U.S., Hong Kong, Singapore, UK and/or Canada.
- Experience: 4 to 8 years of legal practice focused on privacy and data protection, cybersecurity and emerging technologies.
- Industry Background: Mix of major law firm training and in-house corporate experience preferred.
- Tech Literacy: Understanding of data flows and mapping, cloud computing, and modern IT architecture, and familiarity or interest in the interactive entertainment industry in general.
- Languages: Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese.
- Location: Preferably Hong Kong or Singapore.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

- Certifications: CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM designations are highly desirable.
- Self-starter: Demonstrates high self-initiative and can work with teams to drive projects to pragmatic solutions.
- Communication: Ability to translate complex legal requirements into actionable business advice.
- Dynamic Work Environment: Growth mindset that can thrive in a dynamic, cross-border environment, while working effectively across different disciplines, cultures, and time zones.
