**Company Description
**Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose –to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.
**Job Description
****Team Summary
**The Visa Asia Pacific Legal team manages Visa's legal affairs in the Asia Pacific (AP) region. Our team provides advice and services to ensure business goals are successfully met and that Visa's brand and reputation are protected while minimizing legal liability and regulatory risk. Our vision entails each legal professional living the guiding principles to be a proactive partner who never loses sight of his/her responsibility to protect the company.
**What a Sr. Associate Counsel in Legal does at Visa:
**The position is for a seasoned data privacy, AI and technology attorney to join Visa's growing legal team. This role will focus in particular on supporting Visa's businesses in the AP and CEMEA regions in relation to data privacy, AI and cybersecurity, as a member of Visa’s Global Privacy Office team. The role will also support development and expansion of Visa’s Value-Added Services vertical, which includes Data and Risk Solutions and Managed and Advisory services. The position will report to the Senior Managing Counsel who is Visa’s Regional Privacy Counsel for AP/CEMEA and who leads a small team providing legal support to Visa’s Consulting & Analytics, Risk Solutions and Data Solutions businesses as well as the Risk & Compliance functions within the AP region.
The applicant should have extensive experience of data privacy laws in the AP region, as well as (ideally) commercial, technology, IP and/or financial services laws, and be able to apply this experience to the development of new services and products (including risk and data products) The applicant should preferably have experience of the development and implementation of AI and GenAI-based platforms and systems. The applicant must have solid technical legal skills with good commercial/legal risk judgment and be able to juggle multiple priorities in a fast paced and challenging, but rewarding, environment.
We are looking for a strong legal advisor and commercial lawyer rolled into one with excellent communication and analytical skills, who is self-motivated and willing to work reasonably hard. Prior payments experience is not essential, although the applicant must be willing to learn Visa's business model and the payments industry.
In this role, you are expected to:
* Work closely with country and business teams to review and advise on the legal impact of new or updated data privacy or AI laws on new business initiatives, as well as existing products and services.
* Be an effective representative of the AP Legal team and AP/CEMEA member of the Global Privacy Office, and liaise with other regional and country lawyers in the AP region as well as other members of the Global Privacy Office team in implementing privacy policies and practices in Visa’s global privacy program.
* Assist in regulatory and government engagements/consultations on new laws and regulations (including privacy, AI and cybersecurity) across the AP and CEMEA regions and be an effective partner and advisor to the business and government engagement teams while developing subject matter expertise and contributing to thought leadership in these areas.
* Conduct privacy compliance reviews in various AP/CEMEA markets to ensure alignment with applicable laws, and conduct reviews of various data use cases in support of new business initiatives.
* Be a dedicated resource/go to lawyer for various business functions that are providing products and services to Visa’s clients within the Value Added Services vertical, and play a leadership role in supporting the development and implementation of new data and AI-based solutions in the AP region.
* Drafting of standard product terms and templates for use in support of Visa’s current and new business initiatives across the Asia Pacific region.
* Draft, negotiate and drive to completion complex commercial, technology, or strategic partnership agreements in support of business objectives.
* Provide advice and guidance to product teams regarding deal structures and key risks and on identifying and resolving legal issues.
**Why this is important to Visa:
**The Sr. Associate Counsel will play a key role as a trusted advisor to businesses that represent one of the most important pillars of Visa’s future growth and strategy. This role is critical in ensuring that legal risks are identified and managed efficiently with relevant stakeholders while enabling our business to innovate and push across new frontiers (particularly in the fast-evolving technology, innovation, AI and data space). The Sr. Associate Counsel can look forward to being a key representative of a high performing legal team in advising and managing projects that drive innovation and development within the payments industry.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
**Qualifications
****What you will need:
**We are looking for a strong lawyer who can bring breadth of experience and strong subject matter expertise in support of our business. As a candidate, you should have:
* Strong academic credentials, including a degree from a well-recognized and reputable law school
* Minimum 8+ years data privacy, AI and technology transactions experience, some of which must be at a top tier law firm or MNC
* Be able to work independently and interface with executive level stakeholders with little or no supervision, but also be a good team player
* Be a practical and proactive problem-solver, must have a strong business acumen and be confident, mature and calm under fire
* Demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly and concisely with multiple stakeholders including senior executives
* Demonstrate an ability to manage and drive complex commercial and technology transactions, including international and regional deals
* Strong understanding of data privacy, AI, technology and commercial laws in multiple AP (and preferably also CEMEA) jurisdictions
* Excellent project management skills and experience, particularly in data privacy program management
* Excellent legal analytical skills with the ability to integrate legal advice and business knowledge, while providing balanced advice regarding risks and benefits
* Be admitted to practice in Singapore or in a Commonwealth jurisdiction
**Projects you will be a part of:
**You will be a member of a regional legal team that works at the cutting edge of new payment technologies, innovation and the fintech industry in an increasingly regulated environment, which brings unique and novel challenges in the commercial/technology law space.
**Additional Information
**Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

### Senior Privacy Counsel

Bandwidth Inc. Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium

# Senior Privacy Counsel

#### Bandwidth Inc. Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium 4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Bandwidth Inc. has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

Who We Are:

Bandwidth, a prior “Best of EC” award winner, is a global software company that helps enterprises deliver exceptional experiences through voice, messaging, and emergency services. Reaching 65+ countries and over 90 percent of the global economy, we're the only provider offering an owned communications cloud that delivers advanced automation, AI integrations, global reach, and premium human support. Bandwidth is trusted for mission-critical communications by the Global 2000, hyperscalers, and SaaS builders!

At Bandwidth, your music matters when you are part of the BAND. We celebrate differences and encourage BANDmates to be their authentic selves. #jointheband

What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for an experienced, curious, and collaborative attorney with 7+ years of experience in privacy and data protection to join our Legal Team. This role can be based at one of Bandwidth’s offices in Europe, the UK, or our headquarters in Raleigh, North Carolina.

The Senior Privacy Counsel will provide expert legal guidance and operational support to drive responsible growth and support compliance with global privacy laws. You will be the second member of the Privacy Team and report to the VP, Deputy General Counsel in the United States (based in North Carolina) who leads Bandwidth’s Privacy Program.

What You'll Do:

- Advise business stakeholders and support compliance as a subject matter expert on privacy and data protection requirements in connection with Bandwidth’s products, services, and operations worldwide.
- Draft, review, and negotiate privacy terms in service, software and telecommunications agreements, including agreements with customers, vendors, and partners and/or carriers, in support of and close coordination with the Commercial Legal Team and Global Regulatory team. Develop and contribute to templates, playbooks, and training to support the Commercial Legal with resolution before escalation.
- Research and deepen your expertise in global privacy laws, AI legislation, and emerging tech regulations, with a special emphasis on Europe and UK (unpacking acronyms such as the GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, the EU AI Act, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework); provide practical guidance on implementing new requirements to business stakeholders and other members of the Legal team.
- Lead and assist in the completion of risk assessments such as privacy by design product review, PIAs, DPIAs, AI risk reviews, and transfer impact assessments on a prioritized basis to support the goals of the Bandwidth Privacy Program and new business initiatives.
- Assist other members of the Legal Team with cross-functional legal issues involving governmental and regulatory compliance, including the management of retention periods and regulatory obligations relevant to communications service providers.
- Serve as a spirited champion for privacy and AI awareness across the company–creating and delivering training, fielding questions, and keeping teams informed and empowered.
- Own, manage, and continuously strive to improve processes, procedures, and operational functions of the privacy program; assist in the creation and upkeep of our privacy and AI notices and disclosures, policies, and internal guidelines and resources to ensure they are clear, current, useful, and aligned with our operational objectives.
- Lead and contribute to investigation, mitigation, and response to privacy incidents and regulatory inquiries on an as-needed basis, and assist in the development of incident response protocols.
- Advise on cybersecurity laws and regulatory frameworks in collaboration with our Global Regulatory and Information Security teams; support implementation, monitoring, and compliance in connection with third-party and customer standards for data protection and data security, including ISO 27001/27701/42001, SOC II, NIS2, and customer audits.
- Research and liaise with our external DPO and outside counsel to obtain specialized advice on topics that are relevant to data protection and privacy compliance in a new local market where Bandwidth may offer or expand services or operations (such as locations in LATAM, APAC, or other jurisdictions).

What You Need:

Experience: 7+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant privacy and data protection experience, preferably in a law firm or in-house setting.

Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of global privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity laws and regulatory frameworks applicable to technology companies, including the GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, EU AI Act, and NIS2.

Skills:

- Ability to translate complex legal concepts into business-friendly guidance
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills that can flex from casual to formal, including demonstrated ability to negotiate fairly, creatively, and to achieve successful resolution
- Superior legal research, critical thinking, and writing skills
- Ability to work autonomously and to use independent judgment and discretion when making the majority of decisions, and to handle confidential and sensitive information with the appropriate discretion
- Demonstrated ability to lead a variety of tasks, evaluate alternatives quickly, and provide top-quality legal assistance and support to executive-level clients
- A growth mindset—self-aware, reflective, and open to feedback to succeed with confidence and humility
- Desire for constant learning within a rapidly changing environment, adapting approaches and deliverables to suit the evolution of business needs, legal requirements, and company risk tolerance
- A calm, constructive approach to conflict and the ability to influence outcomes with diplomacy
- Appreciation for Bandwidth’s values, especially a commitment to work for and love the success of others - we are here to protect the company and to help our Bandmates succeed at their mission
- Exceptional organizational skills with demonstrated experience creating, managing, and maintaining privacy records (such as ROPAs and PIAs) and/or audit artifacts

The Whole Person Promise:

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

- Work laptop and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home
- We contribute 5-10% of monthly gross salary into your risk insurance , depending on your seniority at the company. This includes retirement, life and disability cover.
- Hospitalization insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
- Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
- Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
- Childcare support
- 100% transportation reimbursed for journeys done by public transport
- Meal vouchers, eco-vouchers, and gift vouchers
- Cycle to work scheme
- 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years. (Please note that the Belgian system grants legal holidays proportionally to the time you have served as an employee in Belgium the prior year)
- Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email
- Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges
- “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild
- 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

### GRC Analyst

# GRC Analyst

#### Jobgether Ireland 1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Jobgether has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a GRC Analyst in Ireland.This role sits at the heart of governance, risk, and compliance operations within a fast-scaling, payments-focused environment. You will take ownership of day-to-day GRC execution, ensuring the organization maintains a strong and continuous compliance posture across multiple regulatory frameworks. Acting as a key partner to engineering, security, legal, and leadership teams, you will help translate complex compliance requirements into structured, operational processes. The role involves managing audits, external trust requests, and ongoing control monitoring in a highly dynamic, remote-first setting. You will also contribute to strengthening policy governance, risk management practices, and security assurance programs. This is a hands-on position where precision, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration directly support trust, regulatory readiness, and business growth.Accountabilities

- Own and manage audit readiness activities, including maintaining continuous evidence collection, control monitoring, and coordination with external auditors for frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001.
- Handle external security and compliance requests, including vendor assessments, security questionnaires, and RFP responses, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery.
- Support and coordinate enterprise risk and compliance programs aligned with regulations such as GDPR, DORA, NIS2, and the EU AI Act.
- Maintain and govern the policy lifecycle, including policy updates, exception handling, violation tracking, and remediation follow-ups.
- Contribute to certification efforts and support expansion into new compliance frameworks as business and regulatory needs evolve.
- Collaborate with engineering and security teams to operationalize controls, strengthen vulnerability management processes, and support security awareness initiatives.
- Ensure ongoing compliance visibility by maintaining structured documentation and reinforcing a continuous compliance approach rather than point-in-time audits.

Requirements

- 3-5 years of experience in GRC, compliance, information security governance, or a related field.
- Hands-on experience supporting external audits such as SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, or equivalent frameworks.
- Familiarity with regulatory requirements including GDPR, DORA, NIS2, and ideally emerging EU compliance standards.
- Experience managing vendor risk assessments, third-party due diligence, and external security reviews.
- Strong understanding of continuous control monitoring and evidence management practices.
- Proficiency with GRC and compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, or similar tools.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple compliance workflows in parallel.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, legal, and business stakeholders.
- Detail-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving compliance gaps.
- Ability to work independently in a remote-first, fast-moving, and ambiguity-rich environment.
- Nice to have: familiarity with IAM processes and access reviews, certifications such as CISA, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, and experience in fintech or payments environments with PCI DSS exposure.

Benefits

- Fully remote and globally distributed work environment.
- Competitive compensation and equity/share options (where applicable).
- Flexible time off with generous minimum holiday allowance.
- Home office setup support and access to co-working spaces.
- Private medical insurance and health-related benefits (depending on location).
- Learning and development budget to support continuous growth.
- Annual company retreats, workations, and global team gatherings.
- High-quality equipment provided for your role.
- Additional region-specific perks and benefits.

How Jobgether WorksWe use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether?Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

AI安全体系搭建：结合国内外相关法律法规，搭建AI全生命周期安全治理体系，制定模型准入规范、安全开发标准、风控管理基线，规范算法研发、模型上线全流程安全流程。6. 全流程风险防护：覆盖AI训练、微调、推理、部署、应用全链路安全。管控训练及推理数据安全，完成数据脱敏、去标识化、版权合规校验，防范数据投毒、敏感信息泄露；针对LLM大模型、多模态模型开展鲁棒性测试、对抗样本防御、偏见审计、模型水印溯源。7. 应用层安全防御：负责RAG知识库、智能Agent、向量数据库安全治理，搭建防护机制，抵御提示词注入、越狱攻击、越权访问、模型窃取等常见AI攻防风险；优化AI防火墙、敏感信息防泄漏网关等安全工具。8. 攻防与应急赋能：定期开展AI安全渗透测试、红蓝对抗、模型代码审计；跟踪行业前沿AI攻防技术；面向算法、研发团队开展安全培训，同时处置云上、AI业务相关的安全突发事件。

1. 本科及以上学历，计算机、信息安全、人工智能、等相关专业；

职位描述

公司简介智信达科技有限公司是政府扶持的高科技企业，属于人工智能大数据行业，公司是专门为人工智能技术提供数据支持的企业，主要业务是对数据进行标注处理，具体岗位工作内容：将人类可识别的信息数据（如图片），经过电脑简单的处理之后，让这些数据变成人工智能可识别的数据，以便使用这些数据训练智能机器和大模型；公司在合肥、淮南等地有多个场地和合作伙伴，由于项目种类多，长期招聘居家办公人员，只需要一台电脑就可以在自己家里轻松上班，没有电脑的只要学会后公司也可以免费提供电脑（电脑只需要交押金，免费使用，不使用退回同时押金全额退）目前拥有场地全职人员80多人和线上居家兼职人员500多人。常见岗位种类介绍：1.图像标注员（视频标注）：对图片中的物体，文字，视频等识别标注2.文本标注员：对文本数据进行分类、实体识别等3.语音标注：对给定的语音进行转写成文字、情感分析等4.3D、4D点云标注：对激光雷达的点云数据进行标注，作业环境常为自动驾驶和机器人领域5.大模型标注6.项目经理：带领团队作业，负责具体项目标注质检和交付新人几个常见问题一：这是个什么活，有什么前景，怎么干？ 1这个岗位的名称叫数据标注员，属于人工智能大数据行业行业，国家工信部定义该岗位为 人工智能训练师（可以考证考级）。 2现在很多大学也开了这个专业，这个行业属于爆发期，大量需要人才，对于我们怎么干怎么理解，我给大家举几个例子，（自动驾驶，大模型，比如现在流行的大模型Deepseek就是我们这个行业，淘宝扫一扫就知道了，扫描笔等），讲直接点就是教机器人认识东西，比如一张图片上有人有车，我们把人和车分别框起来，然后标记是人事车，这张图片就算完成作业了。有专门老师培训，大家不要怕学不会，新的行业，听着难，学起来不难。二：这个活的特点及工资结算标准和结算时间，以及一个月能挣多少 钱 这个活的形式是以数据包的形式，我分任务给你（或者你从平台上领取数据包任务），至于你每天什么时间干，不限制，可晚上可白天，自由。工资结算的标准都是次月结账，次月20到25号左右，我举个例子（1月份的工资是2月20号左右结，），但是有个前提，必须干够一个月（想不干了提前15天和我们说），干不够1个月的***。不提前讲自己不干的扣15天工资。正常一个月2D 1000—3000,文本及大模型项目1500到3000元；3D项目2500-5000.具体自己能开多少工资看能力。公司待遇模式是：责任底薪+提成+奖励三：干这种活需要我们具备什么能力1.高中（中专）以上学历2.年龄45岁以内，智力正常，没有色盲3.关键是有耐心和毅力（因为这个活简单，就是重复的工作），难点就是自制力如何4.我们公司所有培训和学习资料是免费的，有任何收费可以投诉（V：MLJ-567）5.正常学习培训周期是3到7个工作日，之后就可以正常居家作业了6.培训过关，公司和你签订结算协议，保证双方权益六：注意事项：1.都是远程平台作业，每日作业自己统计，明明白白2.平均日作业时间不低于3小时（或对应工作量），节假日放假、周末双休3.可以线上参与学习培训，也可以来场地学习，均为免费4.具体项目有专门老师和专门群，一个人最多同时学习2个项目5.项目不合适可以找马会长（V：MLJ-567）调换项目，前提是作业的项目要处理完成公司承诺不无故拖欠工资，无故拖欠工资按每日赔偿0.5%操作 淮南市智信达科技有限公司 2025年3月

## 公司简介

北京中保国信融资担保有限公司成立于 2011 年，注册资本 10 亿元，是中农惠民天汇集团有限公司控股的一家国有担保公司。是北京市首批取得北京地方金融监督管理局颁发的长期融资性担保许可证的融资担保公司，专业为各类型企业或个人提供项目融资担保、消费贷款担保、股权质押担保等融资担保服务及工程履约担保、诉讼保全担保等非融资性担保服务。2014 年末，中保国信成为中关村担保联盟核心成员单位，并同期当选首都金融商会担保协会副会长单位，全面助力中小企业的发展。 公司成立至今，一直保持稳健的经营理念，经营情况持续良好，严格按照北京市金融局监管要求开展担保业务；响应政府有关部门号召，为中小微企业提供多元化的产品服务；从企业的初创期、成长期到成熟期，从高新科技企业到文化创意产业，每一个阶段都有匹配适合企业的产品服务，根据企业实际情况为其推荐不同的融资担保服务；我司一直致力于稳健中求创新，创新中求发展，发展中求共赢的经营理念，完善自身业务产品，适应市场需求，力求更好的帮助解决企业融资问题。 中保国信严格按照现代企业制度要求组建，并完全按照市场化原则运营，拥 有强大的管理团队，建立健全了完善的经营管理及内部风险防控制度，并自主梳理并建立了一套担保业务操作流程及内部信息化办公系统，以防范风险、加强化解风险能力为目标，系统的建立了信用担保体系。在发展壮大的过程中不断提高技术水平、丰富业务内容、完善管理体制、加强内部培训、提升业务素质，未来，公司将继续秉承“专业、创新、高效、诚信”的企业文化，进一步帮助中小微企业解决融资难的问题，为本市的经济发展做出更大的贡献。

### 产品平台运营（广告风控业务）-国际化

20k-40k 经验3-5年 / 本科

内容资讯,短视频 / D轮及以上 / 2000人以上

职位职责： 1、负责国际化业务广告风控平台的日常运营管理，主导功能优化与落地执行，覆盖广告审核、质量管控、人力调配及风险管理等全领域，提升平台整体效能； 2、深度挖掘、梳理平台用户反馈，结合业务短期目标与长期发展规划，精准排序需求优先级并转化为清晰的业务需求文档； 3、联动产品、研发及运营团队，推动产品功能与业务流程迭代，在达成业务目标的同时持续提升用户体验； 4、通过数据指标持续追踪产品性能与项目成果，驱动决策优化； 5、独立操盘复杂跨职能项目，从问题定义、方案设计到落地执行全程负责，确保项目高效推进与成果交付； 6、快速响应并处理用户反馈的系统漏洞及平台突发问题，保障平台稳定运行。 职位要求： 1、本科及以上学历，软件工程、数据分析等相关专业背景者优先； 2、3年以上产品运营、产品/项目管理或咨询相关工作经验，具备成熟的业务落地能力； 3、优秀的英语听说读写能力，可作为工作语言流畅沟通； 4、具备出色的跨部门沟通与协调能力，擅长管理多级利益相关方，在项目管理与团队协作上有扎实经验； 5、对问题解决有强烈驱动力，工作积极主动，责任心强，逻辑思维清晰缜密； 6、数据敏感度高，精通数据解读与分析，坚持以数据驱动业务决策与优化。

### 高级前端工程师（人工审核方向）-国际化内容安全平台

25k-50k 经验3-5年 / 本科

#### Recruitment Specialist at AB InBev GCC India | Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) | DevSkiller Certified

Message Thanmayi Yadav

Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser-Busch InBev. The centre leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.

Do You Dream Big?

We Need You.

Job Description

Job Title: Principal Analyst - Global Digital Risk & Data Protection

Location: Bangalore (Onsite)

Reporting to: Director - Tech Compliance

PURPOSE OF ROLE

- We are looking for a highly motivated Data Protection Specialist with hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data protection, and security operations. This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment and is passionate about protecting enterprise data, reducing insider risk, and strengthening security resilience across modern cloud and hybrid ecosystems.

- You will play a critical role in operating, enhancing, and scaling enterprise data protection capabilities across endpoints, email, cloud applications, collaboration platforms, and business processes. The position requires a blend of technical expertise, operational excellence, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement of mindset.

KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

Key Responsibilities

Data Protection & DLP Operations

- Manage and continuously improve enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls, policies, and operational processes.
- Execute technology roadmaps for DLP platforms to address evolving business needs, data exposure risks, and threat landscapes.
- Implement and optimize controls across data in motion, data at rest, and data in use environments.
- Review existing configurations, recommend enhancements, and support future deployments across enterprise environments.
- Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms to drive proactive monitoring and risk reduction.

Security Technologies & Controls

Operate and support multiple enterprise security technologies, including:

- Data Loss Prevention solutions
- Microsoft Purview / M365 Security
- Exchange Online Protection
- Retention Policies & Records Management
- Sensitivity Labels & Information Rights Management (IRM)
- Web Proxy / URL Filtering Controls
- Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
- Private Access / Zero Trust Access Solutions
- Cloud Data Protection Platforms
- Encryption Solutions
- Password Management / Privileged Access Tools

Incident Response & Risk Mitigation

- Coordinate mitigation of data protection incidents and alerts across multiple geographies/zones.
- Investigate, prioritize, and drive closure of incidents within defined SLAs.
- Identify and mitigate risks related to data leakage, theft, insider threats, and policy violations.
- Support management of high-criticality and case-based security incidents.

Phishing Simulation & Awareness

- Lead end-to-end phishing simulation programs, including:
- Threat trend analysis
- Campaign design & template creation
- Testing & execution
- Validation of results
- Reporting & insights
- Tool administration (e.g., Go Phish)
- Work closely with awareness teams to improve employee cyber resilience.

Encryption & Data Security

- Support deployment and management of enterprise encryption controls across devices, email, databases, and cloud platforms.
- Apply strong understanding of:
- Symmetric Encryption
- Asymmetric Encryption
- Hashing Techniques
- Leverage Microsoft 365 encryption capabilities and other enterprise tools.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Partner with global teams to understand requirements and execute operational priorities.
- Support workshops, knowledge sessions, and user guidance documentation.
- Be prepared to handle sensitive and high-priority assignments from senior leadership.
- Promote a strong security-first culture and compliance mindset across the organization

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS

Education:

- BE/B Tech/MCA in IT, Computer Science or Electronics and Communication or similar qualification

Experience:

- 4 – 6 years of experience in Data Protection, DLP, Security Operations, or Information Security roles.
- Experience working in large, dynamic, and globally distributed environments.

Technical/Functional Skills:

Mandatory Skills:

- DLP platforms (Microsoft Purview, Netskope, Sentinel One, Mimecast)
- CASB
- Cloud Data Protection (VMs, APIs, SPNs, Configs Exposure review etc.)
- Proxy technologies
- Email Security
- Endpoint Security
- Encryption methodologies
- Data security controls
- AI/ML use cases in Security

Preferred (Good to have) Skills:

- HTML/CSS
- Scripting
- Automation
- Phishing tools
- Microsoft 365 Security stack

Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of in-store and e-commerce lease-to-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing, Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform.Wе аrе сurrеntlу hіrіng а Lead Data Governance Analyst tо hеlр grоw оur соmраnу аnd еnѕurе оur mіѕѕіоn іѕ асhіеvеd! Thіѕ rоlе іѕ а wоrk-frоm-hоmе роѕіtіоn аnd саn bе реrfоrmеd rеmоtеlу аnуwhеrе іn thе соntіnеntаl UЅ оr in оur соrроrаtе office іn Utah. WЕ АRЕ: We’re an entrepreneurial, high-ownership team building data-driven products in the Fintech space. We set a high bar for ourselves and we expect everyone on the team to do the same. We move fast, but we’re deliberate: decisions are grounded in data, rigorous analysis, and a deep respect for real-world impact. YОU АRЕ: А drіvеn data governance рrоfеѕѕіоnаl. You will play a critical role in scaling and operating our enterprise data governance program. This role is responsible for owning governance processes end‑to‑end, partnering with business and technical stakeholders, and ensuring data across the organization is trusted, well‑defined, and fit for use. This is a hands‑on, independent role: you will both execute core governance activities and design and improve the governance operating model as the organization evolves. You will act as a primary point of contact for data governance across domains, serving an escalation point for complex governance issues and establish the vision for future data governance initiatives. Yоur Dаy-tо-dаy

- Own day‑to‑day execution of the data governance operating model across multiple data domains
- Drive the creation and maintenance of governance artifacts, including: Business glossary and data definitions, Critical data element (CDE) identification, Metadata, lineage, and usage context
- Establish, document, and maintain clear data owner and data steward roles, responsibilities, and decision rights
- Create policies and procedures to outline requirements and how they will be met
- Track governance adoption and effectiveness using pragmatic metrics (coverage, usage, issue resolution cycle times)
- Serve as an escalation point for governance exceptions and data‑related risk issues
- Execute RFPs

Yоu’ll Вrіng

- 5–8+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, data quality, or related disciplines
- A Mаѕtеr’ѕ dеgrее
- Demonstrated experience operating (not just designing) a data governance program
- Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and bring structure to evolving environments
- Experience working cross‑functionally with business, analytics, engineering, and risk/compliance stakeholders
- AI-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done across our organization, and that’s only going to expand over time. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to learning as roles and workflows evolve.

Yоu Міght Аlѕо Hаvе

- Exposure to machine learning
- Knowledge оf DеvОрѕ and Gіt
- А trасk rесоrd оf agentic AI use and implementation

Wе Оffеr

$40.00/hr - $80.00/hr

Biotech Health Data Governance Lead (AI Training)About The RoleWhat if your expertise in biotech data governance could directly shape how AI understands and handles the most sensitive, high-stakes data in science? We're looking for a Biotech Health Data Governance Lead to ensure that clinical trial and research data is accurate, traceable, compliant, and ready to power scientific discovery, regulatory submissions, and advanced AI-driven analytics.This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for experienced professionals in life sciences, clinical research, or regulated data environments. If you know how to bring order, trust, and rigour to complex research data — we want to hear from you.

- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Govern biotech research and clinical trial data to ensure accuracy, lineage, and auditability for scientific analysis and regulatory submissions
- Define and enforce data policies covering classification, access controls, security, and metadata across research, clinical, regulatory, and partner teams
- Enable secure, governed access to data assets for analytics, innovation, and external collaboration — while protecting confidential and patient-related information
- Identify data quality gaps and implement standards that support both scientific integrity and regulatory readiness
- Work cross-functionally with scientific, IT, compliance, and business stakeholders to align data workflows and governance frameworks

Who You Are

- Experienced in leading or implementing data governance programs within biotech, life sciences, clinical research, or similarly regulated data environments
- Deeply familiar with data privacy, security, compliance obligations, and regulatory expectations for research and clinical trial data
- Skilled at translating complex governance requirements into practical policies and workflows that real teams can follow
- A natural collaborator who can bridge the gap between scientific, technical, and compliance perspectives
- Detail-oriented and systematic — you understand that in regulated environments, the quality of the data is the quality of the science

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI training data pipelines
- Familiarity with frameworks such as FAIR data principles, CDISC, or ICH E6 GCP guidelines

The Department The Customer Strategy, Insights and Innovation (CSII) Division identifies and leads the customer journey for all stakeholders across the Club ecosystem. The Division centralises the Club’s customer understanding and insights across owners, members and wagering customers, striving for innovation via our Digital and Retail channels. Through enhanced data provision & insights, and online / offline customer strategies devised, improve the channels’ and segment teams’ ability to enhance customer experience, drive wagering turnover and groom customers up the tiers. The Job You will:

- Develop and implement a comprehensive data governance framework for the enterprise data warehouse, aligning with industry best practices and organizational objectives
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and enforce data governance policies, standards, and procedures
- Establish data ownership and stewardship roles, ensuring clear accountability for data quality, accuracy, and integrity
- Monitor and manage data quality by establishing data quality metrics, conducting regular audits, and implementing corrective actions as needed
- Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure data privacy and security regulations are adhered to, including GDPR, PIPL, and other relevant standards and policies
- Lead data classification efforts, determining data sensitivity levels and access controls based on business needs and regulatory requirements
- Collaborate with IT teams to ensure data lineage, metadata management, and data cataloging are maintained and accessible to relevant stakeholders
- Drive data governance awareness and training programs to enhance data literacy and encourage adherence to established policies
- Evaluate and implement data governance tools and technologies to enhance data management capabilities within the data warehouse
- Stay current with industry trends and advancements in data governance and share insights with the team to drive continuous improvement

About You You should have:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Management, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
- Minimum of 15 years of experience in data management, with 8 years specifically in data governance roles.
- Strong knowledge of data governance principles, frameworks, and best practices.
- Familiarity with data privacy and security regulations and their implications on data governance.
- Proficiency in data management tools and technologies, such as data cataloging, metadata management, and data quality tools.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different teams and levels of the organization.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
- Leadership experience and the ability to motivate and manage a team.
- Professional certifications in data management or data governance (e.g., Certified Data Management Professional, DAMA Certified Data Governance Professional) is a plus.
- Sound understanding of business dynamics and its key value drivers
- Knowledge of data governance solutions in the market
- Understand technical of large scale data analytics platform
- Knowledge of the Club’s business functions and wagering products is preferred
- Project Management Professional Certification (optional)

Terms of Employment The level of appointment will be commensurate with qualification and experience. Enquiries We are an equal opportunity employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with the Club's notice to employees and prospective employees relating to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance. # Head of Data Architecture and Governance

#### Peabody London, England, United Kingdom 3 weeks ago 68 applicants See who Peabody has hired for this role

- Report this job

Our VacancyAs the Head of Data Architecture & Governance you will strategically lead Peabody’s enterprise data architecture and data governance agenda as two connected foundations for trusted, secure and reusable data. You will set the direction for how data is designed, modelled, integrated, governed and assured across our modern cloud data platform, helping Peabody make better use of data for residents, colleagues, compliance and innovation.What You’ll Do

- Define and oversee Peabody’s enterprise data architecture, including data models, integration patterns, design standards and architecture principles across operational and analytical data.
- Provide architectural leadership for data products, platform evolution and AI/ML use cases, ensuring solutions are scalable, interoperable, secure and aligned with Enterprise Architecture.
- Lead and mature Peabody’s group-wide data governance framework, including ownership, stewardship, policies, standards, critical data elements and clear accountabilities across domains.
- Shape the approach to metadata, lineage, cataloguing, classification and information asset management, making data easier to discover, understand, trust and reuse.
- Partner with data platform, engineering, product, architecture and business teams to embed governance and architecture controls across the full data lifecycle.
- Lead Peabody’s approach to responsible data use and AI governance, ensuring ethical, secure and transparent use of data in line with Peabody’s values and regulatory expectations.
- Provide assurance and clear reporting on data architecture, governance and data risk to senior forums, including Data Council, Executive Committee, Board and audit stakeholders.
- Lead, coach and develop a small specialist team, while influencing data owners, stewards and senior stakeholders across the organisation.

What You’ll Need

- Proven leadership experience in data governance, data management, or enterprise data quality in a large, complex organisation
- Strong enterprise data architecture expertise, including conceptual, logical and physical modelling, data integration, cloud data platform patterns and architecture assurance.
- Deep understanding of data governance frameworks, metadata management, and data stewardship models, with ability to embed in practice
- A degree in a data related field, and / or certifications such as Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or AWS Certified Data Analytics
- Experience with data management and governance tools such as Unity Catalog, Purview, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Informatica, or Talend
- Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of ethical principles in data use, particularly in the context of resident data, AI and advanced analytics
- Experience of working within or leading aspects of a federated or hub-and-spoke data operating model
- Strong understanding of the relationship between systems, data processes and governance across the data lifecycle

Why Join Us?When you join Peabody, you’re joining a team guided by our values, Be Kind, Do the Right Thing, Love New Ideas, Celebrate Diversity, Keep Our Promises, and Pull Together. We believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels supported, included, and empowered.What We Offer

- 30 days’ annual holiday, plus bank holidays
- Two additional paid volunteering days each year
- Flexible benefits scheme, including family friendly benefits and access to a discount portal
- 4 x salary life assurance
- Up to 10% pension contribution

Please Read Before ApplyingPeabody does not provide sponsorship as a licensed UK employer.If this sounds like we are right for you and you’d love to be part of Peabody, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply now by submitting an anonymised CV and a short statement explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role.If you have any questions about this role, please email Talent Specialist, Ryan Loasby at ryan.loasby.@peabody.org.ukThe closing date for this advert will be the 23rd June. However, we reserve the right to close this advert early should we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

Purpose of the JobThe Caucasus Cluster Digital and SFP Data Governance Manager is responsible for spearheading digital transformation and consumer data management across Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan. This role focuses on unifying CRM systems, optimizing digital solutions and infrastructure, ensuring robust data governance, managing budgets and projects, and maintaining strong relationships with external digital agencies and partners. The position also serves as a central hub of expertise, supporting market general managers and SFP heads in achieving their business goals and enhancing consumer experiences.Principal Accountabilities

- CRM Strategy and Unification:
- Develop and implement a strategy to unify CRM systems across the three markets, ensuring a cohesive view of consumer data and streamlined operations.
- Standardize CRM workflows to support consumer programs, allowing for market-specific communications while maintaining a unified operational framework.
- Lead the transition to a unified CRM Digital Consumer Engagement (DCE) platform, evaluating its commercial viability and potential cost savings.
- Manage the efficiency of e-CRM channels, including messengers and social media, to optimize reach and engagement, ensuring cost-effective and impactful consumer interactions.
- Ensure compliance with local data privacy regulations, collaborating with Legal and External Affairs teams to safeguard consumer data and maintain regulatory compliance.
- Digital Solutions Development:
- Oversee the creation and integration of digital solutions, including microsites and other tools, to support consumer programs and marketing campaigns.
- Standardize digital solution development processes across markets, providing strategic guidance to maximize synergy and efficiency.
- Share best practices across markets to accelerate implementation and optimize investment in digital tools, enhancing the overall consumer experience.
- Digital Infrastructure Management:
- Act as the primary architect of the cluster's digital infrastructure, leading unification and optimization efforts to ensure sustainable, compliant, and scalable solutions across the cluster.
- Partner with IT and digital teams to plan and maintain digital infrastructure, focusing on cost-effective scalability and maintenance.
- Collaborate with customer care and call center teams to integrate infrastructure solutions that enhance consumer support and engagement.
- Market SFP Support and Collaboration:
- Build strong relationships with market SFP heads to understand and analyze their needs, providing tailored digital solutions and data insights.
- Facilitate the achievement of business goals by supporting the development of consumer programs and marketing activities, ensuring a consistent SFP experience across platforms.
- Ensure seamless integration and optimization of the consumer journey across all touchpoints and platforms.
- Consumer Data Governance:
- Oversee consumer data governance, standardizing methods for data analysis, storage, and reporting.
- Collaborate closely with IT, as well as the commercial analysis and planning department, to manage data warehousing and integration, ensuring robust data management practices.
- Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations, working with Legal and External Affairs teams to protect consumer data.
- Budget Management and Optimization:
- Manage the budget for digital initiatives, ensuring efficient allocation and control of resources.
- Monitor and evaluate budget performance, implementing cost-saving measures and optimizing financial efficiency.
- Cluster Project Management:
- Lead and oversee cluster-wide digital projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.
- Track project progress and performance, providing regular updates to stakeholders and making strategic adjustments as needed.
- Organizational Development and Expertise Center:
- Develop and enhance the digital team's capabilities, proposing optimal organizational structures to maximize synergy and efficiency.
- Serve as the central expertise hub for digital initiatives, offering strategic insights and best practices to market general managers and SFP heads.
- Promote a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in digital and data governance.
- External Partner and Digital Agency Management:
- Manage relationships with digital agencies and external partners, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic goals and digital initiatives.
- Achieve efficiencies and cost savings through synergies, optimizing resource allocation and project delivery.
- Oversee contract negotiations, performance evaluations, and ongoing collaborations with external partners to deliver high-quality digital projects.
- Ensure that external partners adhere to brand standards, compliance requirements, and project timelines, fostering long-term partnerships that enhance digital capabilities.
- E-commerce Development and Support:
- Support markets in scaling up and developing e-commerce capabilities, bringing best practices and innovative strategies to enhance online sales and consumer engagement.
- Collaborate with local market teams to optimize e-commerce platforms, ensuring seamless integration with other digital channels and CRM systems.
- Monitor e-commerce performance, providing insights and recommendations to improve conversion rates, customer satisfaction, and overall digital sales performance.

Skills and Competencies

- Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead digital transformation and CRM integration projects across multiple markets.
- Technical Expertise: Extensive knowledge of CRM systems, digital solutions, data governance, infrastructure management, and external agency collaboration, with a strong understanding of consumer data standards and privacy regulations.
- Collaboration and Relationship Building: Strong skills in building relationships with market leaders, cross-functional teams, and external partners, including digital agencies.
- Analytical and Decision-Making Skills: Strong analytical abilities to assess data trends, system performance, and make data-driven decisions.
- Communication and Influence: Excellent communication skills to articulate strategies, influence stakeholders, and foster a collaborative environment across markets.

Experience

- Digital (E-CRM, E-Com) Experience with monolith and DCE,
- Snowflake
- Managing in-house or off-site development teams, Digital agencies management.
- APIs
- Python
- Data governance (Data architecture, data sources integrations)

# Data and Artificial Intelligence Governance Lead

#### argenx Ghent, Flemish Region, Belgium 1 year ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who argenx has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

- Report this job

argenx is a global immunology company committed to improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases and cancer. Partnering with leading academic researchers through its Immunology Innovation Program (IIP), argenx is translating immunology breakthroughs into a world-class portfolio of novel antibody-based medicines. argenx’s first experimental medicine, efgartigimod, is being evaluated in multiple autoimmune diseases, including myasthenia gravis (MG), immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), and chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP). argenx is located in Ghent, Belgium, Boston, Massachusetts and Tokyo, Japan.We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data and Artificial Intelligence Governance Lead to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for strategizing and implementing relevant governance frameworks, policies, and procedures to ensure the integrity, security, and effective use of data and AI solutions in the Discovery, Development and Quality (DDQ) organizations, in close collaboration with other areas.Key Responsibilities

- Develop and implement a federated Governance Frameworks to ensure:
- Adoption of the FAIR principles in a Data Mesh model: Design and establish data governance frameworks, including policies, standards, and procedures to ensure data quality, integrity, and security.
- Company wide applicable frameworks for responsible & ethical use of AI
- Stewardship:
- Define data stewardship activities with business functions and data owners, ensuring data is managed and used in compliance with regulatory requirements and best practices.
- Define engagement policies to enable AI solutions use in compliance with applicable regulations
- Data/AI Governance Ecosystem: oversee the implementation of data/AI governance capabilities including data catalogue, master data management, and data observability in the DDQ space.
- Collaboration: Work closely with data owners, IT, and business units to ensure policies are understood and adhered to and facilitate the adoption of the framework in a federated organization. Assure AI solutions respect data governance policies
- Data/AI Quality Management: Implement and monitor quality metrics, and work with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues.
- Training and Awareness: Develop and deliver training programs to promote data/AI governance awareness and best practices across the organization.
- Compliance: Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and industry standards.
- Reporting: Provide regular reports on data governance activities, data quality metrics, and compliance status to senior management.
- Data/AI maturity: Establish and maintain a data maturity assessment and develop the roadmap to enhance maturity in the DDQ space.

Qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in data and AI governance, data management, or a related field in the life science industry.
- Skills:
- Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and best practices.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience with data management tools and techniques.
- Knowledge of regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, …).
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Offer

- A competitive salary package with extensive benefits
- Front seat in the development of therapeutic antibodies
- A work environment in a human-sized, dynamic and rapidly growing biotech company

I f you have the desire and capacity to support bank’s strategy towards data driven and future proof digital bank this might be the position for you.

Management of data and information is vital for the future success of the SEB Group. Trusted and high-quality data is a necessity for maintaining customer satisfaction, enabling digitalization, automation and regulatory compliance. Thus, we are looking for a delivery-oriented data governance manager with a broad understanding of the positive effects of having sound data management framework and the business opportunities it gives.

You will be a member of Customer Data and Strategic Transformations team in SEB Baltic. The position could be based in one of three Baltic countries (Estonia, Latvia or Lithuania).

Your responsibilities will include:

- Governance - enforce implementation of data governance framework according to Baltic Data Strategy, Data Management Policy. Work closely with stakeholders from all parts of SEB to make sure that short-term and long-term objectives are met, and that data and data quality are important parts of processes, products and mindsets. You will focus on Data Governance to make sure that process, tools and competences are in place;
- Data Management - create awareness and provide trainings in the business and in IT on Data Management. Ensure continuous support to the organization with common standards for organization, roles, capabilities, processes, competence and tools. Support SEB Baltic organization to secure data lifecycle management, data quality and security management;
- Documentation - keep Data Management Governance Policy and relevant internal instructions and documents up to date, prepare guidelines that may be issued in order to facilitate the understanding and interpretation of instructions and/or the policy;
- Strategy - contribute to Baltic Data Strategy and support its implementation. Initiate and/or drive initiatives leading to Technology Architecture improvements in the field of Data Management.

You will be the right fit if you have:

- Passion about Data and it´s management;
- Holistic prespective but the ability to focus on details when needed;
- Experience in digitization, information architecture, information modelling and data quality standards;
- Comfort discussing and communicating logical and conceptual models of metadata as well as business glossaries;
- Good stakeholder management and project management skills, excellent collaboration skills;
- Willingness to share, educate and grow the awareness of the importance to have a sound Data management within the organization;
- Knowledge about Collibra Data Governance tool would be useful.

Benefits we offer:

- Meaningful work in a highly professional and fast-moving environment;
- Being part of SEB Baltic strategy execution;
- Dedicated and supportive team of broad expertise;
- Modern and flexible work environment;
- International development programs.

Learn more about working at SEB https://www.seb.lt/en/career

We are looking forward to your application by January 31, 2023.

Monthly salary range for this position: 3300-4900 EUR (before tax deduction).

The final offer will depend on the experience and competencies of the selected candidate. Overall remuneration package consists of the salary together with other benefits.

Welcome to a community of tech-savvy and passionate employees from all corners of the world. SEB is in fact one of the largest IT employers in the Nordics. Together we future proof a world of financial flows by exploring and implementing modern digital architecture and state-of-the-art technology. We are driven by collaboration, insight, and friendship. But also, a desire to change and improve. All in all, it creates a balance - where life and a stable yet exciting job can co-exist. If you want to shape tomorrow's bank - continue reading and apply today.

**About Tencent**
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.
**Responsibilities**
* Advise on a wide range of legal and commercial matters in the areas of cloud computing, technology licensing, and open source software, and export control compliance.
* Draft, review, and negotiate complex software license agreements, professional services agreements, and other general commercial agreements.
* Collaborate with external counsel and other Tencent attorneys based around the world, including in mainland China, Hong Kong, Singapore, EU, and the US, to provide compliance and regulatory analysis and advice for international business initiatives.
* Identify potential legal issues and pitfalls and devise creative solutions for business teams to efficiently mitigate compliance risks.
* Develop and continuously identify areas of improvement in our internal policies, case and knowledge management, trainings, and processes to ensure operational efficiency and implement practices for alignment with international regulatory standards.
* Develop online training materials and conduct training sessions on compliance and regulatory topics for business stakeholders.
**Qualifications**
* You have five or more years of experience working in a law firm or in-house legal department, in the areas of technology, online platforms, software developers or similar clients.
* You have strong academic credentials and are a member of a relevant Bar or you possess other recognized professional qualifications or equivalent membership. Degree in Computer science or similar subject is additionally preferred.
* You have sound business judgement and the ability to deliver practical, commercially friendly and comprehensive advice.
* You are detail oriented, and have extensive experience with IP transactions, including cloud computing services, technology service and licensing issues.
* You have excellent communication skills and can establish strong working relationships with business stakeholders.
* You have the ability to prioritize in a fast-moving environment and can work independently to manage day-to-day compliance work and handle the end-to-end transaction process from initial contract review through to negotiations and execution.
* You have a good command of Mandarin Chinese and English (both written and oral) as working language to cooperate with international stakeholders and stakeholders who are based in HQ.
The position will be based in either Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, or Singapore.

#### Cathay Pacific Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR 1 year ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Cathay Pacific has hired for this role No longer accepting applications

https://www.linkedin.com/login?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Elinkedin%2Ecom%2Fsearch%2Fresults%2Fpeople%2F%3FfacetCurrentCompany%3D7097%26title%3DLegal%2BCounsel&emailAddress=&fromSignIn=

- Report this job

Role IntroductionReport to : Data Protection ManagerIn this role, you will be part of a team which supports the Data Protection Officer (DPO) team of the Cathay Pacific Group in ensuring compliance with the Hong Kong Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL) and other relevant data protection laws across all regions in which the Cathay Pacific Group operates.This is a great opportunity for a driven, motivated and hard-working individual to be part of a team with responsibility for a global data privacy compliance program and its implementation in practice. This role will give the successful candidate the opportunity to work in a fast-moving and cutting-edge field, within an exciting and multifaceted airline business.The successful candidate will work out of Cathay Pacific Group’s offices in Hong Kong, and will work closely with a wide range of Cathay Pacific Group business units, including Procurement, IT, Digital, and People.Key Responsibilities

- To support the DPO team in managing the third-party privacy risk related procedures. Including to independently review and assess responses provided by third parties through pre-onboarding questionnaires, as well as alerts provided by the pre-onboarding screening system.
- To independently draft, review, and negotiate privacy-related contracts or clauses (e.g. Data Protection Addendums or DPAs), as requested by the Data Protection Manager
- To support the development, and management of internal policies and compliance processes for DPAs, third-party privacy risk, individual right management, and data incident response.
- To independently implement and monitor internal policies and compliance processes for DPAs, third-party privacy risk, individual right management, and data incident response.
- Independently investigate privacy incidents and follow-up the related activities, as requested by the Data Protection Manager.
- Independently coordinate responses to individual rights requests (e.g. access, deletion, rectification, opposition, etc.), as requested by the Data Protection Manager.
- To independently advise on the response of law enforcement data requests (e.g. Police requesting passengers’ data), as requested by the Data Protection Manager.
- Promote strong data protection standards through conducting training and awareness sessions to various Business Units and Outports.
- To independently provide training and raise awareness across the Cathay organisation on all matters listed above, as requested by the Data Protection Manager.
- For applicants without the required legal qualification, will be considered as a Data Protection Lead

Requirements

- A proven interest in global data protection laws and practices, with a focus on PDPO, GDPR, PIPL and other relevant data protection laws in which Cathay Pacific Group operates, and a strong desire to learn how these regimes relate to both customer and employee personal data.

职位描述一、岗位职责（核心突出风控、制度流程建设与投诉举报管理）1. 制度流程体系搭建与优化：主导公司企管类核心制度（如部门协作机制、业务管控流程、权限管理规范、投诉举报管理办法等）的调研、起草、修订与落地推广，建立制度全生命周期管理机制，确保制度的合规性、适配性与可执行性；定期开展制度执行效果复盘，识别流程断点与冗余环节，推动流程精益化优化。2. 全面风控管理落地：参与公司风控体系搭建，聚焦业务运营、流程执行、合规管理、投诉举报处理等关键领域，识别潜在风险点（如流程漏洞、权责不清、合规风险、投诉升级风险等），制定风险防控措施与应急预案；定期开展风险排查与评估，跟踪风险整改情况，形成风控工作报告，降低运营风险。3. 投诉举报全流程管理：建立并优化公司投诉举报处理制度与流程，明确受理范围、处理时限、反馈机制与追责标准；负责投诉举报案件的接收、登记、分流、跟踪督办与闭环管理，组织相关部门开展调查核实，提出处理建议，确保案件处理合法合规、公正高效；分析投诉举报数据，挖掘背后的制度缺陷与流程风险，推动针对性优化。4. 业务流程管控与监督：负责企管相关业务流程的全流程管控，包括流程执行指导、节点审核、异常情况处理，确保业务操作严格遵循制度规范；针对跨部门流程协作中的风险点，建立协同风控机制，推动部门间高效联动；将投诉举报处理结果纳入流程优化依据，持续提升流程合规性与用户满意度。5. 制度与风控培训宣贯：组织开展制度、流程、风控知识及投诉举报处理规范的内部培训与宣贯，提升全员制度敬畏心、风险防控意识与投诉处理能力，确保制度落地、风控要求与投诉举报流程深入人心；收集员工对制度、流程的反馈建议，形成优化闭环。6. 企管数据统计与分析：搭建企管类数据统计体系，收集制度执行率、流程合规率、风险发生频次、投诉举报量、处理满意度等核心数据，进行趋势分析与风险预警，为管理层决策提供数据支撑。7. 协助完成其他企管工作：配合公司战略落地，参与组织架构优化、部门职责梳理、绩效考核辅助等工作，确保企管工作与公司发展目标同频。二、任职要求（明确生产型企业经验优先，强化风控与制度建设能力）1. 学历与专业：本科及以上学历，工商管理、企业管理、行政管理、法学、风险管理、公共事业管理等相关专业优先；具备扎实的企管理论基础、制度建设逻辑框架与风控合规知识储备。2. 工作经验：71 1年以上企管、风控、制度流程建设或投诉举报管理相关工作经验，其中至少1年以上同岗位或相近岗位管理经验（如企管专员主管、风控专员主管、投诉管理主管等）；71 具备完整的制度体系搭建、流程优化或风控体系落地项目经验，能独立主导制度起草、流程梳理、风控方案设计及投诉举报处理流程搭建；71 生产型企业企管相关工作经历者优先，熟悉生产型企业运营逻辑与风控要点者加分。3. 核心能力要求：71 风控能力：熟练掌握风险识别、评估、防控的方法与工具，能精准定位业务流程、投诉处理中的风险点，具备风险预案制定与落地执行能力；71 制度流程建设能力：具备极强的制度文本撰写能力与流程梳理逻辑，能结合业务实际搭建科学、高效的制度流程体系（含投诉举报处理流程），推动制度落地与流程优化；71 投诉举报处理能力：熟悉投诉举报处理的基本原则与流程，具备较强的沟通协调、冲突化解与问题解决能力，能公正、高效处理各类投诉举报案件，防范投诉升级风险；71 合规意识：熟悉国家相关法律法规及行业监管要求，能将合规要求融入制度设计、风控管理与投诉举报处理全过程；71 沟通协调与管理能力：具备跨部门沟通协作、资源整合与团队管理能力，能有效推动制度落地、流程优化、风控措施执行与投诉举报案件协同处理；71 数据分析与解决问题能力：具备基础的数据统计与分析能力，能通过制度执行数据、风控数据、投诉举报数据识别问题、提出优化方案；逻辑清晰，抗压能力强，具备较强的问题解决闭环思维。4. 其他要求：71 熟练使用Office办公软件（Word、Excel、PPT、Visio等），具备流程绘制与制度排版规范能力；71 原则性强，责任心强，具备良好的职业素养、保密意识与客户服务意识。三、我们为你提供1. 舒适生活保障：配备职工宿舍小公寓，打造温馨居住环境；设职工餐厅与园区超市，满足日常饮食及购物需求，让工作生活更便捷。2. 丰厚福利体系：享受带薪年假、各类法定节假日休假福利，同时发放节日福利、生日专属福利，全方位关怀员工生活。3. 广阔发展平台：依托公司完善的人才培养机制与晋升通道，结合岗位核心业务场景，为员工提供丰富的项目实践机会与职业成长空间，助力个人能力与职位同步提升。
